limitations: Snapshot statuses are selected or generated lab states.
Missions other than the curated canon core are synthetic: the recipe generated their titles, staffing, costs and histories.
Two explicit modest objective revisions in the carried missions; narrative extraction is incomplete for arbitrary clients.
Physical external references limited to 50; wire grammar is not narrowed.
Change ids of the new missions follow those of release 1.0 and are ordered by time among themselves only; a new entry can be older than a lower change id.

Release 1.2 reclassifies the participants by the Captain's definitions (C crew, P on-board non-crew Personnel, O outsiders); releases 1.0 and 1.1 are unchanged and keep their classification as history.
Every P reference names a civilian of personnel-v2-large-004 by exact display name; the names of the outsiders drawn from the pools are synthetic.
On-board civilians of the canon missions who are not on the roster stay O by necessity: Clara Sutter.
The correction entries are synthetic audit entries of a records clean-up; they carry no canon claim.

participantClasses.C: Crew: Starfleet crew members, assigned to missions with obligations. A C reference never appears in participantIds.
participantClasses.O: Outsiders, the Others: anyone not on the ship's roster, such as colonists, delegates, patients, visiting cadets, and every kind of creature, humanoid or entity. An O reference is never mapped.
participantClasses.P: Personnel: people on the Enterprise who work or live there and are not crew members, the civilians of the Personnel v2 roster. A P reference names one civilian of the pinned roster by exact display name, so a mapping can resolve it.
